canonical_project: Techno Digital Kolkata Data Center (Bengal Silicon Valley, New Town)
notes: Techno Electric & Engineering's Techno Digital plans/develops a ~20 MW data centre at BSV, AA-II, New Town (North 24 Parganas) as part of a 250 MW multi-city programme (BusinessLine 2021); Wikipedia WB list marks it planned. First-round discovery had it as construction with official operator page; kept as construction with B grade pending operator confirmation.
